verdict.rationale: Raygun is a monitoring/error-reporting tool with alerting integrations (Slack, PagerDuty) and ignore-rules, but no evidence of user-configurable autonomous background automations/agents that act on their own; the MCP server found is client-facing tooling for AI agents to query Raygun, not evidence of Raygun running autonomous background automations itself. No documentation describes scheduled or agentic automation workflows.
